d: Jeeny is a mobile application that eases daily commuting and transportation. Founded in 2012, Jeeny is one of the region’s leading ride-hailing platforms operating across the Middle East, delivering reliable, affordable, and innovative mobility solutions. At Jeeny, we foster a collaborative and fast-paced environment where employees are empowered to make an impact and grow professionally.
We are looking for a high-performing Business Growth/Sales Manager to join our Jeeny for Business (J4B) team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

Reporting directly to the Director of Commercial, you will drive the strategic expansion, commercial growth, and operational execution of our end-to-end B2B corporate mobility solutions across the Kingdom.

In this role, you will build long-term client/enterprise partnerships, identify untapped market opportunities, and launch specialised corporate mobility products with smart go-to-market strategies, positioning J4B as the primary transport platform for companies of all sizes.
q: At least 5 years of proven experience of fast-paced B2B sales or business development experience in KSA, with a strong track record of selling services to SMEs, enterprises, and public sector clients.
A proven ability to source, negotiate, and successfully close high-value corporate deals while consistently exceeding ambitious revenue targets.
Fluent in both Arabic and English and excel at building strong, long-lasting relationships with client decision-makers and internal stakeholders.
Comfortably partners across Operations, Finance, and Product/Tech teams to ensure seamless client onboarding, contract compliance, and service delivery.
Demonstrates high initiative, proactively solve operational and commercial challenges, and take complete ownership of your work and results.
An existing network among corporate travel, admin, and procurement decision-makers in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
Experience responding to government tenders or giga-project procurement processes.
In compliance with local labor regulations and Saudization requirements, this role is reserved exclusively for Saudi Nationals.
r: Build, manage, and execute a strong commercial pipeline across KSA, targeting client segments ranging from high-growth SMEs to multinational Regional Headquarters (RHQs), government bodies, and giga-project contractors.
Lead end-to-end sales cycles from initial outreach and high-level client presentations to negotiating and closing long-term corporate mobility agreements.
Lead the preparation, commercial structuring, and submission of formal RFPs (Requests for Proposals) and government tenders across public sector entities and giga-project developers.

Develop localized GTM strategies to launch and scale new J4B products, customised corporate packages, and specialised service tiers (including employee commuting, event logistics, and executive chauffeur solutions).
Identify untapped market gaps in Saudi Arabia’s corporate transport sector and translate client feedback into actionable product/tech road-map.
Partner closely with client HR, Finance, and Corporate Travel Managers to ensure smooth on-boarding onto the J4B portal.
Monitor account health, drive platform adoption across client employees, and upsell new transport solutions to maximise monthly ride volume and lifetime value (LTV).
Structure competitive corporate rate cards, volume discounts, and customised credit terms while safeguarding healthy unit economics.
Collaborate directly with BizOps Manager(s) to ensure corporate SLA compliance, driver fulfilment rates, and quality standards across corporate executive rides.
Work alongside Finance teams to ensure timely corporate invoicing, payment collections, account reconciliation, and credit limit management across all J4B accounts.
Work alongside Product/Tech teams to translate client feedback and market gaps into scalable portal features, enhanced reporting tools, and seamless enterprise tech integrations.
Track and report on core performance metrics, including Gross Merchandise Value (GMV), corporate active users, and pipeline health.
Deliver weekly commercial updates, revenue forecasts, and strategic market insights.
x: Be part of one of the leading mobility platforms in the region.
Work in a dynamic and collaborative environment.
Opportunity to lead impactful finance initiatives and process improvements.
Career growth and professional development opportunities.

d: Perform laboratory tests accurately and efficiently using approved procedures, techniques, and laboratory equipment.
Ensure proper specimen collection, identification, handling, storage, transportation, and rejection in accordance with approved procedures.
Perform daily quality control checks and ensure compliance with laboratory quality, safety, infection control, SOPs, and regulatory requirements.

Record and maintain accurate laboratory results, reports, and related documentation in the designated systems. · Monitor laboratory equipment, report malfunctions, and ensure proper operation and maintenance.

Manage laboratory inventory, including monitoring stock levels, preparing purchase requisitions, receiving and verifying supplies, processing GRNs, and maintaining accurate inventory records by regular timely issuing on system.
Monitor and analyze laboratory consumption and ensure availability of reagents, consumables, and other required materials.

Register patients in the LDM at collection sites or branches where dedicated customer care staff is unavailable, ensuring accurate patient information, test requests, billing details, and required documentation.
Provide customer care and front-desk support at branches when required, including assisting patients with inquiries, registration, appointments, and service-related requests.
Ensure a smooth and positive patient experience and escalate complaints or issues to the appropriate department when required.
Support branch operations while maintaining laboratory service quality, patient safety, and operational standards.
Assist in training and guiding new employees, interns, and students on laboratory procedures, systems, safety, and SOPs.
Participate in audits, training, process improvement initiatives, and departmental
Maintain patient confidentiality and ensure all activities comply with organizational policies, professional standards, and applicable regulations.
Perform any other duties and responsibilities related to the role as assigned by the direct manager
q: Strong knowledge of laboratory procedures, testing techniques, and specimen handling.
Technical proficiency in laboratory equipment and automated analyzers.
Knowledge of quality control and quality assurance practices.
Knowledge of infection control, laboratory safety, and regulatory requirements.
Ability to accurately perform laboratory testing and interpret quality control results within the scope of the role.
Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
Ability to communicate professionally with patients, medical staff, laboratory staff, customer care teams, and administrative staff.
Customer service orientation and ability to handle patient inquiries professionally.
Ability to accurately register patients and enter patient information into the designated system.
Ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.
Ability to manage multiple tasks and work effectively under pressure.
Good computer skills and ability to use laboratory and patient management systems.
Commitment to compliance with professional, ethical, and organizational standards.

d: Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing
Open Role: Senior Product Marketing Manager

Marketers at Canonical are brand stewards and demand creators.They transform complex open-source technology into messages, stories and strategies that shape the market understanding of our vision. Some focus on differentiated product and portfolio positioning; others specialize in account-based engagement, partner and alliance messaging, or product-led growth. Whatever their specialization, each marketer works as part of a cross-functional unit, contributing campaigns and insights that help the company learn and grow faster.

We have a bias for action, focus efforts on the most impactful activities and take ownership of our results. We work across long buying cycles, balance storytelling with data, design experiments, track outcomes, and iterate rapidly to find what works.

At Canonical, the product marketing team is not just marketing products, we’re building the best Go-To-Market (GTM) engine in the open source world. Our mission is to take the power of open source innovation and bring it to businesses everywhere, from the data center to the edge. We’re growing fast and looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager (PMM) to join our team—someone who loves technology, thrives in fast-paced environments, and wants to make a global impact.

This is a hands-on, multi-disciplinary, and dynamic position, requiring close collaboration with the Product, engineering, content, Sales, and other Marketing teams. The ideal candidate is passionate about technology, technology marketing, and the use of technology in marketing. They prefer to work in an environment that emphasises ownership of GTM campaigns, collaboration, learning, curiosity, and a drive to always improve oneself / the team / the organisation. They love solving problems, getting hands-on, experimenting, measuring, and using automation to make daily life easier.
q: A passion for technology and open source—you get excited about innovation, software, and community-driven development.
Strong storytelling skills—you know how to craft messaging that resonates with both technical and business audiences.
Growth mindset—someone who thrives on experimentation, learning, and continuous improvement.
Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
Data-driven mindset, using insights to refine strategies and improve performance.
Experience in product marketing for enterprise software, cloud, DevOps, or open-source solutions.
Experience with demand generation, understanding how to translate GTM strategies into pipeline growth.
Comfort working cross-functionally with product, sales, partners, and marketing teams.
r: You’ll own the GTM strategy for key products, shaping messaging and positioning that speaks to developers and enterprise buyers alike.
You’ll collaborate cross-functionally with product management, sales, regional marketing, content, and partner marketing teams to bring campaigns to life.
You’ll get creative, crafting compelling advertising, launch plans, and campaigns that make our products stand out in a competitive landscape.
You’ll measure impact, using data to refine messaging, optimize marketing funnels, and drive customer engagement.
You’ll be part of a truly global team, working with colleagues in over 85 countries in a fully remote, high-performance environment.
As a Product Marketing Manager, You Will
Develop and execute go-to-market (GTM) strategies for a range of products.
Lead messaging and positioning efforts ensuring our products stand out in a competitive market.
Lead content planning with product managers —from website copy to whitepapers, blogs, and sales enablement materials.
Collaborate on marketing campaigns, partnering with regional marketing teams to execute integrated campaigns that drive pipeline growth.
Launch new products and features, leading cross-functional teams to drive awareness and adoption.
Run competitive analysis, staying ahead of market trends and evolving our positioning accordingly.
Support the customer success team on driving customer engagement and growth, working on strategies to upsell and cross-sell across our customer base.
Plan and execute global events, live webinars, and community meetups that align with our GTM priorities.
x: Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.

In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, please ask your Talent Partner.
Fully remote working environment - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!
Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum
Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at ‘sprints’
Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.
